name: deck-author
body: The deck author as a domain actor — the same individual as requirements.user.deck-author and solution.person.deck-author: writes slide content in Markdown/YAML, runs kalide init/start/templates, and presents the deck live in a browser; not a developer. requirements.user.deck-author represents this entity, and this entity represents solution.person.deck-author, so it is linked to the solution tier only through `represents` -> solution.person.deck-author; it has no realised-by (a person is not realised by software).
